integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Live-action cinematic realism, single-take locked medium-wide two-character coverage; action 林岚坐在screen-left长椅外端并低头；screen-right doorway为空；钥匙不可见。 -> 林峻从screen-right doorway进入并在安全距离停下，以anatomical right hand小幅举起唯一旧黄铜钥匙并只说一次指定逐字台词；林岚听见后先抬眼看钥匙，出现一次可见呼吸微停，再把视线移到林峻眼睛，始终不伸手。 -> 唯一旧黄铜钥匙清楚可见并由林峻anatomical right hand稳定持有；林峻停在screen-right安全距离；林岚screen-left seated并注视林峻眼睛，不伸手。; action endpoint change required true; performance trigger Lin-Lan hears Lin-Jun's exact line and sees the worn brass key become visible in his anatomical right hand.; visible response Lin-Lan raises her eyes to the key, pauses one visible breath, then moves her gaze to Lin-Jun's eyes without reaching; Lin-Jun contains his urgency and waits.; gaze Lin-Jun looks toward Lin-Lan along the established axis; Lin-Lan looks first at the key and then at Lin-Jun's eyes.; body Lin-Jun stops at the safe-distance mark without leaning or stepping closer; Lin-Lan remains seated with a restrained small reaction and no exaggerated surprise.; hands Lin-Jun's anatomical right hand alone raises and continuously holds the one key; his other hand does not offer or transfer it; Lin-Lan's hands do not reach for it.; terminal performance Lin-Jun holds position and waits for a response; Lin-Lan remains seated, alert and visibly attending through eye contact and one settled breath.; palette restrained cool-gray rainy-night environment with muted navy and charcoal wardrobe and the worn brass key as the only warm metallic accent; materials natural skin texture, rain-darkened woven outerwear, damp window glass and a worn matte brass key with controlled readable highlights; lighting from fixed cool spill from the rain-darkened waiting-room window plus one dim warm overhead waiting-room practical, cool window light remains from the exterior window side while the overhead practical provides a stable soft top fill; neither source changes side or intensity during the take; exposure priority preserve readable natural faces, the small brass key and rain-darkened clothing without flattening the night interior or clipping wet highlights; lighting continuity the same cool window spill, dim warm practical, restrained contrast and wet-surface response remain constant from first frame through the 5.000s endpoint; subject positions 林岚全程坐在screen-left长椅外端；林峻从screen-right doorway进入并停在screen-right安全距离；两人之间的bench center保持中立且无人跨越。; screen direction 林岚从screen-left看向screen-right的林峻；林峻从screen-right面向screen-left的林岚。; entrance 0.000s时screen-right doorway为空；林峻仅从该doorway进入并在screen-right安全距离落定。; exit 无人离开；林岚保持screen-left seated，林峻保持screen-right，钥匙仍由林峻anatomical right hand持有。; space crossing policy No axis crossing, no side swap and no movement through the neutral bench-center zone.; camera axis The fixed camera remains on one side of the stable left-right line between the bench and the waiting-room doorway, with Lin-Lan screen-left and Lin-Jun screen-right.; framing continuity One locked medium-wide two-character framing continuously preserves the doorway, bench, both faces, left-right relation and visible key.; axis crossing policy Crossing is not authorized; neither character nor camera crosses or reverses the established axis.; camera framing intent medium-wide two-character coverage keeps the screen-right doorway, screen-left bench position, both faces, safe gap and key visible in one continuous frame; start framing locked eye-level medium-wide two-character waiting-room frame: Lin-Lan seated screen-left, screen-right doorway empty, bench and neutral center visible; locked-off camera; camera stability locked-off tripod stability with no drift, pan, tilt, zoom, push, pull or handheld motion; position lock true; orientation lock true; end framing the same locked eye-level medium-wide frame: Lin-Lan seated screen-left looking at Lin-Jun, Lin-Jun stopped screen-right holding the visible key in his anatomical right hand; motion 林峻从screen-right doorway以克制步幅进入并在安全距离平稳停下。 -> 林峻的anatomical right hand只做一次小幅钥匙举起，同时说出唯一逐字台词。 -> 林峻保持钥匙可见并等待；林岚完成抬眼、一次呼吸微停与从钥匙到林峻眼睛的单次视线转移。; motion direction Lin-Jun moves inward from the screen-right doorway only to the screen-right safe-distance mark; Lin-Lan remains screen-left and only her gaze travels from the key to Lin-Jun's eyes.; motion amplitude small bounded entrance and key lift with micro-amplitude listener gaze and breath response; pacing 0.000-1.400s entrance and stop; 1.400-1.700s key lift; 1.700-3.900s exact dialogue once while Lin-Lan raises her gaze; 3.900-5.000s breath pause, eye contact and endpoint hold.; tempo restrained even unhurried single-take tempo with a readable terminal hold; duration 5.000s; prohibit extra people, duplicated characters or a duplicated key, axis reversal, side swap, framing change or camera drift, wrong-hand key ownership, forced handoff or exaggerated reaction, flashback, imagined scene, visible text or subtitle imagery; no visible text, captions, or subtitles
overall_soundscape: ambience steady soft rain heard outside the waiting-room windows with quiet enclosed room reflections, continuous for the full take; explicitly silent false; foley restrained footsteps end when Lin-Jun reaches the safe-distance mark, one small cloth rustle as Lin-Jun stops, one subtle metal key-ring movement as his anatomical right hand raises the key; speaker Lin-Jun says once <d>[Chinese]钥匙还在。回去，一起开门。</d> from 1.700s to 3.900s; on_screen=true; response obligation Lin-Lan remains silent, raises her gaze from the key to Lin-Jun's eyes, pauses one visible breath and does not reach for the key.; lip_sync_required=true; no narration and no extra speech
